title: capinfos: Fix printing sections info (do not print irrelevant information in sections loop)
description:
It looks like there are incorrect scope braces in the section loop, and some items (packet comments, IP addresses, etc.) are processed (printed, freed) multiple times (`wtap_file_get_num_shbs()`) instead of once.

Found by fuzzer: there are 2 sections in PCAP, on the first iteration some resources were printed and freed (`g_free(p->cmt)`), on the second iteration there is a crash when reading these resources.

![image](/uploads/6bc01cd6f1bd25dcaab75787c6eabe09/image.png)
